justification: Standard: replaces a CI gate (typed planning figures) from a per-file count to a named ledger; no production code or data change.

pre_impl.existing_data: No database access. Reads shipped source files under frontend-nextjs and services.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old gate counted figures per file and named none, so the allowed set grew from 245 to 261 and nothing was removed.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Extends the existing lint script and its test file; the old count file is replaced by .claude/regulatory_figure_ledger.json.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A new typed figure is added anywhere scanned, a widened shape is dropped from the patterns, the unlisted/gone/open-rise checks are removed, or Markdown scanning is turned off.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Six break-checks each turned the tests red (ratio shape, constant shape, unlisted check, gone check, open-rise check, Markdown scan) and green when restored. The real tree reads 0 unlisted with 346 open.

functions.name: hits_in_text
functions.input: one file's text and its suffix
functions.output: every typed planning figure on lines with a planning word

functions.name: judge
functions.input: the scan result and the ledger document
functions.if_none: an empty scan with an empty ledger passes

break_it.scenario: A developer types 'minimum 450 m2' in a new page.
break_it.what_happens: Before: allowed if the file count did not rise elsewhere.

break_it.scenario: A figure is fixed but left in the ledger.
break_it.what_happens: The list would drift from the code.

break_it.scenario: Someone marks a figure as a quote to hide it.
break_it.what_happens: A typed rule passes as cited.
break_it.how: cited needs an instrument and a clause number in the reason

break_it.scenario: A rule is written as prose with no number.
break_it.how: Output-side provenance check is the next PR
